_comment: Copy this file to mail.config.json and fill it in.
mail.config.json is git-ignored, so addresses never reach the public repo.
Your password does NOT go in here - see setup-mail.ps1.
_provider_note: Gmail:  smtp.gmail.com        port 587   (needs 2-Step Verification + an App Password)
Yahoo:  smtp.mail.yahoo.com   port 587   (needs an App Password)
IDPL:   smtp.office365.com    port 587   (needs IT to allow Authenticated SMTP)
_from_note: 'from' must be the SAME address you authenticate as - Gmail and Yahoo both
rewrite the sender otherwise. 'fromName' is what students actually see.
'replyTo' is where their replies go: put your real IDPL address there so
you never have to monitor the sending account's inbox.
_recipients_note: Everyone here is BCC'd, so students never see each other's addresses.
